title: Execute the never-executed safety guards: the evidence floor in every adapter, the ambiguous-cell path onto the material Z0 gate, and the None/blank fact skips on the publication path
objective: Nine safety-relevant lines that are reachable on ordinary provider input have never been executed by ANY test, with or without a database. The worst is the EVIDENCE FLOOR -- the guard that refuses a candidate carrying no evidence location -- which exists in FIVE separate implementations. On a product whose first rule is that no unsupported claim that a service is free may ship, the guard enforcing 'there must be evidence' has never been shown to execute. Give every one of these paths a test, with a paired positive control so none can pass vacuously, and make it impossible for a NEW adapter to escape the evidence-floor sweep.
materiality: Zero-cost safety and evidence integrity, the two criteria the product's first rule rests on. `requires_card` and `has_paid_dependencies` are the two fields that decide Z0_TRUE_FREE versus Z1_BILLING_EXPOSURE; a provider rewording one table cell reaches the ambiguous-value path. `_coerce` returns None for an empty cell, so the publication path's None/blank skips are ONE BLANK TABLE CELL from live, and the failure mode is a published quota row whose raw text reads 'None'.
evaluation_level_rationale: Touches provider adapters and evidence extraction, Z0 classification, and the automatic publication path. Level 2 is mandatory for all three under docs/AGENT_HARNESS.md.

step_zero_remeasurement.why: The finding was traced twice by independent instruments, but BOTH runs had no DATABASE_URL. That is the OFFLINE suite only; the DB-gated layer -- the entire publish pipeline and read API -- was never traced. The accurate claim before this slice was 'never executed by the offline suite', NOT 'never executed by any test'.
step_zero_remeasurement.method: Two instruments sharing no implementation (`sys.settrace` global-call filter; `sys.monitoring` LINE with DISABLE), each run as a SEPARATE pytest process, over the WHOLE suite, against a live throwaway postgres:16-alpine (the image CI uses) on an isolated port. Seven target files traced in full so a floor could be applied.

instrument_controls.floor: Refuse to report any verdict unless >=200 distinct lines were traced overall AND >=200 in html.py. MEASURED: 1471 total, 676 in html.py. Floor cleared by 7x.
instrument_controls.attachment: Each report reads the tracer back at session finish (`sys.gettrace() is _global`; `sys.monitoring.get_tool`/`get_events`). Both reported ATTACHED.
instrument_controls.positive_controls: 9 lines known to execute (the first statement of all five `validate()` methods, the to_bool normalisation, the revalidate loop header, the matrix row-loop body, the _span attribute lookup). ALL 9 reported HIT by BOTH instruments.
instrument_controls.negative_control: A deliberately DETACHED arm (same plugin, tracer never installed) reported 0 hits and attached=False for every target AND every positive control -- establishing what a silently-failed instrument looks like, and that it is distinguishable from the real runs.
instrument_controls.self_test_both_arms: A planted test calling `to_bool('maybe')` made `_common.py:44` report HIT in both instruments; a sibling test exercising only unambiguous tokens made the SAME line report NOT HIT while lines 37-43 still reported HIT. The instrument can therefore both pass and fail.
instrument_controls.cross_instrument: The two instruments' hit sets for the DB arm are BYTE-IDENTICAL (1471 lines each, all 10 target verdicts and all 9 control verdicts agreeing).

step_zero_remeasurement.verdict: THE FINDING STANDS, and is now measured over the population it was previously only assumed to cover.

finding_the_brief_did_not_have.fifth_implementation: The brief names FOUR implementations of the evidence floor. There are FIVE: `apps/api/app/ingest/reference.py:112` carries the identical message and `JsonOfferAdapter` there is a real concrete `SourceAdapter` subclass. Discovery over the tree finds exactly 5 concrete adapters.
finding_the_brief_did_not_have.and_it_is_worse_not_better: That fifth line IS executed -- by `tests/unit/test_ingest_contract.py::test_reference_adapter_validate_flags_missing_fields`, which builds a `CandidateFacts` with the default `evidence=()` and calls `validate()`. But that test asserts only the two MISSING-FIELD messages. So the evidence floor there is EXECUTED AND UNASSERTED: a line-coverage tool calls it covered, and deleting the guard would not fail a single test. Four guards are invisible to coverage; the fifth is invisible DESPITE coverage. This is why the fix asserts behaviour, not execution.
finding_the_brief_did_not_have.no_drift: The brief warned every line-number hint had 'PROBABLY DRIFTED'. I re-located all ten independently: ZERO drift. All ten land exactly where hinted (T10 at 476 within the hinted 475-476).

design_decisions.one_parameterised_test_not_five: The defect being repaired IS DRIFT BETWEEN COPIES. Five separate tests would recreate the exact structure that let the property rot unevenly. One test, parameterised over a DISCOVERED adapter list, asserts all five emit the IDENTICAL message -- so a reworded copy fails.
design_decisions.discovery_not_a_hand_typed_list: The parameter list is produced by importing every module under `apps/api/app/ingest/**` and collecting concrete `SourceAdapter` subclasses whose `__module__` is that module (so re-exports are not double-counted). The list is never typed out, and never copied from the task brief.
design_decisions.the_floor_that_makes_escape_impossible: A separate assertion requires the discovered set to equal the set of adapters this file knows how to build. Adding a sixth adapter therefore FAILS this test until its evidence floor is swept. Plus a vacuity floor (>=5 adapters, >=15 modules walked) so a broken walk cannot pass by finding nothing.
design_decisions.what_None_must_mean_on_the_Z0_gate: UNKNOWN, never 'no card required'. AGENTS.md: 'A failed or unknown material Z0 condition prevents Z0 classification.' The engine already honours tri-state None; what was never tested is the BRIDGE -- that an ambiguous source cell actually arrives as None rather than being coerced to False somewhere between the table cell and OfferFacts. The test drives the whole chain and asserts the classification is not Z0.
design_decisions.positive_controls_everywhere: A test asserting 'rejected' passes just as well when the code rejects everything. Every check here is paired with an accepting arm: the evidence floor sweep asserts the SAME candidate WITH evidence produces no floor message and that the ONLY difference between the two arms is the floor message; the Z0 chain asserts a clean 'No' cell still classifies Z0_TRUE_FREE and a clean 'Yes' cell classifies Z1; revalidate asserts a normal value still produces its quota row; the matrix tests assert the well-formed table still extracts.

acceptance_criteria: Every one of the ten target lines is EXECUTED after the change, re-measured by BOTH instruments, with the floor and all positive controls still passing
The evidence floor is asserted BEHAVIOURALLY for all five adapters by ONE parameterised test whose parameter list is discovered, not typed

Adding a sixth adapter without wiring it into the sweep fails the discovery floor
Every new test has a paired positive control that must come out the other way
